Analyst
-------

           rule: analyst.trade_efficiency, 20 feature row(s) cited

           rule: analyst.pivotal_round, 4 feature row(s) cited

Economist
---------
  [critical] Red broke its buy 2 times (R12, R19) -- rounds where the escalated loss bonus should have funded a real buy and the team went in short anyway.
           rule: economist.broken_buy_count, 2 feature row(s) cited
  [warning] Red force-bought 3 rounds back to back (R1, R2, R3). One force is a read; a run this long means the team never got off the back foot long enough to rebuild.
           rule: economist.consecutive_force, 3 feature row(s) cited
  [warning] Red force-bought in 8 of 20 rounds (40%), past the 30% mark where forcing stops being a read and starts being a habit.
           rule: economist.force_buy_frequency, 20 feature row(s) cited

provenance.detail: val-match-v1 requires a Riot production key. Matches here are generated by an in-repo simulator that emits payloads in the documented val-match-v1 shape, grounded in real agent and map UUIDs fetched live from val-content-v1. Nothing is scraped and no unofficial API is used. Every module downstream of the match adapter is source-agnostic, so live data swaps in with no code change.

conclusions.claim: Red broke its buy 2 times (R12, R19) -- rounds where the escalated loss bonus should have funded a real buy and the team went in short anyway.
